dogecoin.text: @cb_doge Who owns Dogecoin? The late Elon Musk wouldn't own Dogecoin until he tweeted that Doge is going to the moon. Now, this is happening again with memes for Empire X. What you're saying doesn't make sense.

@cb_doge Who owns Dogecoin?
The X-Empire currency is owned by Elon Musk. Elon didn't even own Doge before he tweeted that Doge is going to the moon. Your own pic shows Elon Musk in an empire suit. Trump mentions Lil X and Elon himself brings his son into the Oval Office...
